svg.aria-label: Four ways to destroy the control board: a driver inserted the wrong way round, a driver without its heatsink, an ST-Link on jumper wires, reversed supply polarity
svg.text: Four ways to destroy the control board
1. A stepper driver module inserted the wrong way round
2. A driver running without its heatsink cemented on
3. An ST-Link on jumper wires, without the programming adapter
4. Reversed supply polarity on the XT30: it has no protection
Check all four before the first power-on. None of them is repairable.
